description: Land Acquisition - Modara, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically involves the divestment of specific land allotments (with detailed descriptions of lots, boundaries, and extents) by the Minister of Lands and Land Development. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative actions, including the transfer of land ownership and detailed property descriptions, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the land-focused content and does not involve detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification.
